english.note: Use 報道 when the report is a news account presented by the media.
This is the all-purpose choice for coverage given by news or other media.

examples.english: The TV report says the bridge will be closed today.
examples.traditional: 電視台嘅報道話，條橋今日要封。
examples.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 ge3 bou3 dou6 waa6 tiu4 kiu4 gam1 jat6 jiu3 fung1

examples.english: This scandal has been getting a lot of coverage on TV news.
examples.traditional: 呢單醜聞最近喺電視新聞有好多報道。
